errors.text_span: Четвъртата линия е синя, със сини кръгли маркери и пунктирана линия, означена като „Average of w/o DPO obo“. Тя започва при стойност 0.107 при Relation Category 0 и достига максимум 0.107 при Relation Category 60.
errors.evidence: This describes a horizontal line as if it were a dynamic line that starts at a point and reaches a maximum. This is a fundamental misinterpretation of a constant horizontal line. Furthermore, the average lines do not have markers.

errors.text_span: Петата линия е оранжева, с оранжеви триъгълни маркери и пунктирана линия, означена като „Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint“. Тя започва при стойност 0.107 при Relation Category 0 и достига максимум 0.107 при Relation Category 60.
errors.evidence: This description misinterprets a constant horizontal line as a dynamic one. It also incorrectly states the line has triangular markers (it has none) and gives the wrong value (0.107 instead of the correct 0.158).

errors.text_span: Тя започва при стойност 0.107 при Relation Category 0 и достига максимум 0.107 при Relation Category 60.
errors.evidence: The value for the orange average line ('Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint') is 0.158, not 0.107.

errors.text_span: Шестата линия е зелена, с зелени триъгълни маркери и пунктирана линия, означена като „Average of DPO“. Тя започва при стойност 0.086 при Relation Category 0 и достига максимум 0.086 при Relation Category 60.
errors.evidence: This describes a horizontal line as if it were a dynamic line that starts at a point and reaches a maximum, which is incorrect. It also incorrectly states the line has triangular markers, when it has none.

errors.text_span: The “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint” line starts at 0.158

errors.text_span: The “DPO” line starts at 0.18, peaks near 0.19 at x=60, and ends near 0.086.
errors.evidence: The DPO line does not peak at x=60; its value at x=60 is near its minimum at approximately 0.09. One of its highest peaks is around x=23 with a value of approximately 0.2. Furthermore, its end value is not 0.086; 0.086 is the average value for the entire line.

errors.text_span: The average lines are mostly flat
errors.evidence: The average lines are perfectly flat horizontal lines, not 'mostly flat'.

errors.text_span: The plot includes numerical annotations for the starting values of the “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint” line (0.158), the “w/o DPO obo” line (0.107), and the “DPO” line (0.086).
errors.evidence: This is a fundamental misinterpretation. The numerical annotations on the y-axis correspond to the values of the horizontal 'Average' lines, not the starting values of the fluctuating data lines.
